snippet.title: Formula Legends: Late 2020’s Season Pack | New DLC and Free Content Trailer [GOG]
snippet.description:

https://www.gog.com/game/formula_legends_late_2020s_season_pack

The Late 2020’s Season Pack brings present-day racing to Formula Legends. This new DLC introduces 8 new teams, each with 2 drivers and custom helmets, along with 2 new liveries per team, a new championship, updated next-generation season rules, and a brand-new track — all fully integrated into Story Mode.

Free new content for the base game expands the core Formula Legends experience to playfully capture over 70 years of open-wheel motorsport - spanning 19 different eras of rules and regulations and 14 locations featuring 33 different track configurations. Formula Legends is not an experience that is light on content.
